   ```python
   def simulate_rotation(board, quadrant, direction):
       # quadrant: 1,2,3,4
       # direction: "clockwise" or "counterclockwise"
       new_board = dict(board)
       q = quadrant
       
       # Get cells in this quadrant
       cells = [(r, c) for r in [1,2,3] for c in [1,2,3] if (q,r,c) in board]
       
       # Remove old positions
       for r, c in cells:
           del new_board[(q,r,c)]
          
       # Add rotated positions
       for r, c in cells:
           color = board[(q,r,c)]
           if direction == "clockwise":
               # (1,1)->(1,3), (1,2)->(2,3), (1,3)->(3,3)
               # (2,1)->(1,2), (2,2)->(2,2), (2,3)->(3,2)
               # (3,1)->(1,1), (3,2)->(2,1), (3,3)->(3,1)
               # Formula: new_r = c, new_c = 4 - r  (since 1-indexed, size 3: 4-r)
               new_r = c
               new_c = 4 - r
           else:  # counterclockwise
               # (1,1)->(3,1), (1,2)->(2,1), (1,3)->(1,1)
               # (2,1)->(3,2), (2,2)->(2,2), (2,3)->(1,2)
               # (3,1)->(3,3), (3,2)->(2,3), (3,3)->(1,3)
               # Formula: new_r = 4 - c, new_c = r
               new_r = 4 - c
               new_c = r
           new_board[(q, new_r, new_c)] = color
          
       return new_board
   ```
